question: What are the key risks for Diginex?

beats.line: The ESG reporting landscape stays highly fragmented, with standards varying across jurisdictions and industries.
beats.headline: FRAGMENTED STANDARDS
beats.action: A halftone paper document stack drops onto a paper map grid and settles, its sheets fanning apart into uneven tiers.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] The ESG reporting landscape stays highly fragmented, with standards varying across jurisdictions and industries.

beats.line: So data quality, reliability and comparability pose significant challenges.
beats.headline: DATA RELIABILITY
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the document stack tilts; a cream paper ribbon already runs from it to the paper map grid, and mismatched sheets slip loose.
beats.delivery: So data quality, reliability and comparability pose significant challenges.

beats.line: If Diginex fails to deliver auditable, regulatory-grade data, credibility with institutional clients could suffer.
beats.headline: CREDIBILITY AT RISK
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the loose sheets gather back into the document stack; a paper hand presses a rubber stamp down and lifts it, leaving the mark torn, the cream ribbon still in place.
beats.delivery: If Diginex fails to deliver auditable, regulatory-grade data, credibility with institutional clients could suffer.

beats.line: The sharp decline in the share price suggests investor expectations have not been met.
beats.headline: SHARE PRICE FALL
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the torn stamp mark unfolds into the paper price chart; its line tears downward and holds at the low corner.
beats.delivery: The sharp decline in the share price suggests investor expectations have not been met.

beats.line: Revenue growth has been strong, up two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.
beats.headline: +293% TO $2.0M
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper price chart's torn line rebuilds into a rising paper bar chart; an orange paper arrow unrolls from it toward a paper acquisition folder, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '+293%' sits beside the arrow with a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] Revenue growth has been strong, up two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.

beats.line: The strategy leans on acquisitions and partnerships, so execution is the key risk after Resulticks.
beats.headline: EXECUTION RISK
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the orange arrow lands in a paper acquisition folder; paper clips press onto its edge one by one and the folder strains open, the arrow still running back to the paper price chart.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] The strategy leans on acquisitions and partnerships, so execution is the key risk after Resulticks.

beats.line: Adoption stays uneven across sectors and geographies. Smaller firms may delay on cost or complexity.
beats.headline: UNEVEN ADOPTION
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the acquisition folder flattens into a paper map grid; small paper buildings rise across it, some standing and some staying folded flat.
beats.delivery: Adoption stays uneven across sectors and geographies. Smaller firms may delay on cost or complexity.

beats.line: If ESG stays underprioritised, sales cycles may lengthen, slowing recurring revenue growth.
beats.headline: LONGER SALES CYCLES
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the paper map grid rolls into the paper calendar strip; the strip stretches out month by month and stops, a cream string trailing from its far end.
beats.delivery: If ESG stays underprioritised, sales cycles may lengthen, slowing recurring revenue growth.

beats.line: Diginex must educate the market, streamline onboarding and demonstrate return on investment.
beats.headline: PROVE ROI
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the cream string pulls the paper calendar strip back into the document stack; a paper hand squares the sheets and lays a clean stamped ribbon across the top.
beats.delivery: Diginex must educate the market, streamline onboarding and demonstrate return on investment.
